firstAttempt.renderPrompt: Render ONE continuous cel-shaded 2D anime shot, using <Video 1> as the motion and camera guide. Follow the movement, viewpoint and camera direction from this source shot. Replace the original 3D source characters in every frame, including the first and last frames. <Picture 1> is the exact identity for short dark-brown tousled hair, slate-blue eyes, navy and gold coat and fringed epaulettes, ivory trousers and dark boots. Side medium shot, quickly rise by the rose chair and make an exaggerated playing-to-the-room gesture. Keep the same pose timing and camera, with no added cuts or stray characters. Fully clothed comic animation. Any stage prop is openly stylized, with abstract theatrical lighting. Keep each intended hairstyle and costume legible, including when a character is shown from behind. No added words, watermarks, subtitles or dialogue.

review.observations: 逐帧对照本镜 20 帧。蓝金军服、粉椅和开头俯身都保留，过半以后人物抬身和高举手臂也随原镜发生。原镜结尾的关键动作是靠回椅中，把近侧手臂和道具送进画面右前景，远处的脸相对较小。候选末段两手空着，人物仍居中半站，改成张手和放射线特效。右侧前景动作缺失，无法和下一镜切换对上，本版拒收。

retakeAtCheckpoint.prompt: One continuous anime shot, seated by the same rose chair for the entire clip. Follow <Video 1> for the close to wide canted camera and continuous movement. <Picture 1> is the exact dark-haired navy and gold officer. Begin with him folded forward near the right arm of the rose-pink chair, head down and both hands low, upper body filling the frame. As the camera turns and pulls wider he snaps his head and shoulders back toward screen left and lowers himself against the chair. One hand raises a solid rounded gold stage baton from below and reaches it out to the RIGHT foreground near the lens. His other hand opens loosely on the LEFT as he reclines. The last frames must match the canted pose and foreshortened gold baton on the right in <Picture 2>, held at that scale while his face remains behind. His body never stands fully. One character, no jump cut, drawn speed lines, extra prop, gun, text, or dialogue.
